name: print-social-lakeside-tree-swing-cover-with-light-caps
title: Golden-hour photo of an old tree with a swing by the sea with giant light caps and small notes
whatItIs: A portrait photo of a big bare tree with a blue rope swing at the sea in warm dusk light, with a small logo at the top, a small caps line, giant light white 'ЖИТТЄВЕ ПРИЗНАЧЕННЯ?' at the lower left, a two-line asterisk note and a curly arrow at the lower right.
whatItMeans: Reflective and nostalgic; the empty swing suggests reflection.
techniques: Place big light caps over darker lower area.
Use a small caps lead-in above.
Add an asterisk note and arrow.

vocabulary.definition: A headline placed at the bottom of a photo.
A small caps line above a big headline.
A curly arrow hinting at the next slide.
A photo taken in warm low sun.
